name: Account Balance SD 12
definition: Provides additional information regarding account balance. Contains transaction details of the stock loans, repurchase agreements (REPOs) and undelivered trades (FAILs).

PlaceAndName.name: Place And Name
PlaceAndName.definition: Xpath to the element that is being extended.

UncoveredProtectBalance.name: Uncovered Protect Balance
UncoveredProtectBalance.definition: Balance of all uncovered protect instructions across all options.

InvestmentUnpledgedBalance.name: Investment Unpledged Balance
InvestmentUnpledgedBalance.definition: Position held in DTC segregated account also called account 18. This position is not eligible for instruction processing but will be eligible for payment on mandatory events.

InvestmentPledgedBalance.name: Investment Pledged Balance
InvestmentPledgedBalance.definition: Position held in DTC segregated account also called account 22. This position is not eligible for instruction processing but will be eligible for payment on mandatory events.

MemoSegregationBalance.name: Memo Segregation Balance
MemoSegregationBalance.definition: Position held in DTC memo segregated account. This position is eligible for payment.
